items.snippet: make dev-quickstart builds the local smokedmeat-cloud-shell image, starts cloudflared, nats, and the C2 teamserver (Kitchen), then launches the operator TUI from source. If you want the infrastructure first and the operator TUI later: make dev-quickstart-up make dev-quickstart-counter ... More deployment modes and local development details are in docs/deployment.md.
